caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object consisting of two main connected sections, both rendered in varying shades of brown. The upper section has a chevron-like form with additional decorative carving, including a central five-pointed star and smaller star shapes on each side. The bottom section is slightly curved and wider, decorated with a carved image of a spread-winged eagle in the center, flanked by additional five-pointed stars on either side. Detailing on the eagle includes outstretched wings and a shield covering its chest, with feathers and other accents carefully outlined. The object appears to be made of carved wood, with the grain visible throughout, and the drawing is set against a plain, off-white background. There is a small, cursive signature beneath the object on the background.
title: Hanging Comb Rack
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
